text:
Steward direction (Kormie, 2026-09-05): MNEME must install via MDM on every employee laptop and travel with the person

Said in session while PR 23 was open. Two memories from one capture: the person's own memory (one Core per human, one permit per write, the store a file they carry) and an organizational memory. In spec terms the organizational memory is a partition with a secrecy class under the agora seed, written into only through a CapToken the person mints (scope, expiry, holder) and CoreBind: pull by consent, never push by policy, because agora's never-clause forbids a domain that spies on collaborators. MDM installs the capture and the personal loop; joining the org partition is a per-person twin install, steward-gated and 0.11-shaped. Packaging (installer, per-user data dir, hook merged into settings, optional launch agent) crosses no gate. See helix/PROPOSALS.md.

Agent notes checked into a repo are the first honest projection of organizational memory

A dated jsonl of agent-note packets under helix/fixtures/agent-notes is reviewable in a PR, carries declared provenance, and enters each person's memory only through their own Core. Personal memory stays in the person's store; the repo holds engineering knowledge about the repo. A packet origin field (person, host, repo) is needed before a note means the same thing in both places.
